# Talker alias (DMRA) and GPS (DMRG) packets for radio 3191868, as MMDVMHost 9384d683 writes them to DMRGateway (mmdvmhost)
# and as DMRGateway d751e20e forwards them to a master (dmrgateway). DMRGateway inserts its repeater ID, 00beef01 here, and
# then writes the length of the MMDVMHost packet, so the 15-octet DMRA keeps 3 of the 7 data octets and the 14-octet DMRG
# keeps 3 of the 7 position octets (DMRGateway DMRNetwork.cpp:314-352). The writers of both programs were compiled from
# source and run on 2026-10-22 in the e2e interop lane:
# /home/reddragon/.claude/jobs/a75b2a9e/tmp/e2e/iapps/gwgps/net_vectors.txt (NOTES.md in that directory has the method).
# 7bit_KN4OQW is the 7-bit alias "KN4OQW" (header only), 7bit_call_name the 7-bit alias "KF5XYZ Jacob" (header and block 1),
# utf16_KN4OQW the UTF-16 alias "KN4OQW" (header and block 1), and dallas a GPS position.
# Columns: the writer, the vector, the packet.
mmdvmhost 7bit_KN4OQW 444d524130b43c000d2e7349f46b80
dmrgateway 7bit_KN4OQW 444d524100beef0130b43c000d2e73
mmdvmhost 7bit_call_name 444d524130b43c00192e335b166d20
mmdvmhost 7bit_call_name 444d524130b43c0195871efc400000
dmrgateway 7bit_call_name 444d524100beef0130b43c00192e33
dmrgateway 7bit_call_name 444d524100beef0130b43c0195871e
mmdvmhost utf16_KN4OQW 444d524130b43c00cc004b004e0034
mmdvmhost utf16_KN4OQW 444d524130b43c01004f0051005700
dmrgateway utf16_KN4OQW 444d524100beef0130b43c00cc004b
dmrgateway utf16_KN4OQW 444d524100beef0130b43c01004f00
mmdvmhost dallas 444d524730b43c0376554a2e9da2
dmrgateway dallas 444d524700beef0130b43c037655
